title: THE SINKHOLE · The diner
venue: The Unprinted · a Sunday page from a paper he never drew for, found in Box 5 in the private years
logline: A Sunday page in a line almost Wood's, from a Louisiana paper's Sunday section, folded in Box 5 among the unprinted: a diner late at night, a bartender behind a well, a man at Table 14 smoothing his lapels, a dog under a booth. The signature in the margin is a mark nobody at Gully's recognizes. Wood never drew it. It's in his box.

panels.composition: Tier 1: a diner late at night from the door: the counter's stools, a bartender behind a well at the far end wiping a glass, booths along the window, numbered tables in the middle, rain outside as dots.

image.prompt: black and white Sunday comic page in a brush line almost but not quite the strip's own, a diner late at night seen from its door with stools and booths and a bartender behind a bar well at the far end, rain drawn as dots in the window
image.notes: The line is not quite his.

panels.composition: Tier 2: a man at Table 14 in a good suit, alone, smoothing his lapels with both hands, a coffee before him untouched; the table's number on a small stand.

image.notes: Mr. D. Dean's lapels (Vol 5), at Table 14 (D'Ambrosio's). The number: as a shape on the stand.

panels.composition: Tier 3: under a booth, a dog asleep; on the table above it a cassette player with its lid open; the margin's signature a mark nobody at Gully's recognizes.
